So I recently moved into a fairly inexpensive apartment to save money for a house. I figure I can live with almost anything for a year. Noise from dude downstairs? No problem, earplugs are awesome. Drunk dudebro down the hall hitting on me and trying to cop a feel? Chewed out so hard he won't even look me in the eye any more. Life is good! House, here I come!

But then, a few nights ago, I caught a strong whiff of cigarette smoke in the kitchen. As I stood over the sink doing dishes, it got stronger and stronger, my throat started to burn, and I started to cough. Finally, I dried my hands and stepped outside for a fresh breath of air.

And here's where I think I found the problem. The woman who lives below and one apartment over chain smokes (none of the other neighbors do). Usually, she keeps her window open and I just have to deal with eddies of stench occasionally wafting upstairs when I'm on the balcony. But the weather had gotten hot, and she'd probably closed up to turn on the a/c. So the stank that usually flowed out her windows was now seeping into the walls, and into my place.

I haven't been able to locate exactly where it is getting in. Air vents? Outlets? It isn't visible, but it is now getting strong enough that my clothes smell when I'm out of the house, and my throat is constantly raw. It is too hot to open up during the day to air out, but I'm doing it as much as possible as I don't want everything I own to reek permanently.

Two options that are not good:

  1. Talking to Stinky Lady. I've run into her twice while out walking the dog and given a friendly, "Hi!" Which she responds to by staring blankly and lurch-walking away. I'm fairly certain she has a brain/mental issue, and other residents have advised me to stay clear of her as she's apparently rather volatile.

  2. Talking to the office. They Do Not Give A Fuck (see:cheap apartment). In this state, there is no law to support me, and there's no non-smoking language in the lease, so I have nothing to force their hand with.

If anyone has successfully dealt with blocking weird smells between apartments, I would love some tips! The smell is so strong as I type this that my eyes are watering.

I don't actually give a fuck that she smokes, her choice, whatever. I just don't want my place to smell like an ashtray.

TL/DR: Downstairs neighbor is stink-producing hell-beast. How to seal off my place to keep from odiferously signaling the world that I bathe daily in stale cigarette ash?
